mapper.insert: insert into sys_plugin_definition ( plugin_code, plugin_name, plugin_type, description, author, plugin_api_version, builtin_flag, status, sort_no, schema_mode, supports_hot_disable, supports_data_purge, runtime_contributions_json, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) values ( #{entity.pluginCode}, #{entity.pluginName}, #{entity.pluginType}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.author}, #{entity.pluginApiVersion}, 0, 'ENABLED', 0, #{entity.schemaMode}, #{entity.supportsHotDisable}, #{entity.supportsDataPurge}, #{entity.runtimeContributionsJson}, #{entity.createdBy}, #{entity.updatedBy}, 0 ) on duplicate key update plugin_name = values(plugin_name), plugin_type = values(plugin_type), description = values(description), author = values(author), plugin_api_version = values(plugin_api_version), schema_mode = values(schema_mode), supports_hot_disable = values(supports_hot_disable), supports_data_purge = values(supports_data_purge), runtime_contributions_json = values(runtime_contributions_json), status = values(status), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = current_timestamp, deleted = 0

insert into sys_plugin_version ( plugin_code, version, package_path, checksum, signature_path, min_platform_version, install_status, load_status, health_status, lifecycle_status, schema_status, is_active, rollbackable, metadata_json, validation_report_json, staged_path, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) values ( #{entity.pluginCode}, #{entity.version}, #{entity.packagePath}, #{entity.checksum}, #{entity.signaturePath}, #{entity.minPlatformVersion}, 'VERIFIED', 'UNLOADED', 'UNKNOWN', 'INSTALLED', 'PENDING', 0, 0, #{entity.metadataJson}, #{entity.validationReportJson}, #{entity.stagedPath}, #{entity.createdBy}, #{entity.updatedBy}, 0 ) on duplicate key update package_path = values(package_path), checksum = values(checksum), signature_path = values(signature_path), min_platform_version = values(min_platform_version), install_status = values(install_status), load_status = values(load_status), health_status = values(health_status), lifecycle_status = values(lifecycle_status), schema_status = values(schema_status), metadata_json = values(metadata_json), validation_report_json = values(validation_report_json), staged_path = values(staged_path), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = current_timestamp, deleted = 0
mapper.select: select plugin_code, plugin_name, plugin_type, description, author, plugin_api_version, status, builtin_flag, sort_no, schema_mode, supports_hot_disable, supports_data_purge, runtime_contributions_json as runtimeContributionsJson from sys_plugin_definition where deleted = 0 order by sort_no asc, plugin_code asc
mapper.sql: plugin_code, version, install_status, load_status, health_status, is_active, rollbackable, min_platform_version, frontend_manifest_path, validation_report_json, installed_at, created_at, lifecycle_status, schema_status
mapper.select: select from sys_plugin_version where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0 order by created_at desc
select from sys_plugin_version where deleted = 0 order by plugin_code asc, created_at desc

select id, tenant_id, plugin_code, plugin_version, operation_type, lifecycle_status, result_status, detail_message, request_id, trace_id, failure_stack, created_at from sys_plugin_runtime_log where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0 order by id desc limit 200

select d.plugin_code, d.plugin_name, t.plugin_version as version, case when t.enabled = 1 and t.deleted = 0 then 1 else 0 end as tenant_enabled, coalesce(v.lifecycle_status, 'INSTALLED') as lifecycle_status, coalesce(v.schema_status, 'PENDING') as schema_status, case when d.builtin_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end as builtin, d.schema_mode, case when d.supports_hot_disable = 1 then 1 else 0 end as supports_hot_disable, case when d.supports_data_purge = 1 then 1 else 0 end as supports_data_purge, d.runtime_contributions_json as runtimeContributionsJson from sys_plugin_definition d left join sys_plugin_tenant t on t.plugin_code = d.plugin_code and t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.deleted = 0 left join sys_plugin_version v on v.plugin_code = d.plugin_code and v.version = t.plugin_version and v.deleted = 0 where d.plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and d.deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_plugin_version set artifact_path = #{artifactPath}, frontend_manifest_path = #{frontendManifestPath}, backend_jar_path = #{backendJarPath}, install_status = #{installStatus}, load_status = #{loadStatus}, health_status = #{healthStatus}, lifecycle_status = 'INSTALLED', schema_status = 'READY', rollbackable = #{rollbackable}, installed_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and version = #{version} and deleted = 0

update sys_plugin_version set install_status = #{installStatus}, load_status = #{loadStatus}, health_status = #{healthStatus}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, schema_status = #{schemaStatus}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and version = #{version} and deleted = 0

update sys_plugin_version set is_active = 0, rollbackable = case when version <> #{version} then 1 else rollbackable end, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_version set is_active = 1, rollbackable = 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and version = #{version} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_tenant set plugin_version = #{version}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and enabled = 1 and deleted = 0

insert into sys_plugin_menu_rel ( plugin_code, plugin_version, menu_code, menu_name, route_path, icon, permission_key, parent_menu_code, sort_no, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) values ( #{entity.pluginCode}, #{entity.pluginVersion}, #{entity.menuCode}, #{entity.menuName}, #{entity.routePath}, #{entity.icon}, #{entity.permissionKey}, #{entity.parentMenuCode}, #{entity.sortNo}, #{entity.createdBy}, #{entity.updatedBy}, 0 )

insert into sys_plugin_tenant ( tenant_id, plugin_code, plugin_version, enabled, config_json, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) values ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.pluginCode}, #{entity.pluginVersion}, 1, #{entity.configJson}, #{entity.createdBy}, #{entity.updatedBy}, 0 ) on duplicate key update plugin_version = values(plugin_version), enabled = 1, config_json = values(config_json), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = current_timestamp, deleted = 0
mapper.update: update sys_plugin_tenant set enabled = 0, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_tenant set enabled = 0, deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0

update sys_plugin_version set install_status = 'UNINSTALLED', load_status = 'UNLOADED', health_status = 'UNKNOWN', lifecycle_status = 'DISABLED', schema_status = 'REMOVED', is_active = 0, deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_menu_rel set deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_permission_rel set deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_dependency set deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
update sys_plugin_definition set status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select d.plugin_code, d.plugin_name, t.plugin_version as version, v.frontend_manifest_path as manifest_path from sys_plugin_tenant t join sys_plugin_definition d on d.plugin_code = t.plugin_code and d.deleted = 0 join sys_plugin_version v on v.plugin_code = t.plugin_code and v.version = t.plugin_version and v.deleted = 0 where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.enabled = 1 and t.deleted = 0 order by d.sort_no asc, d.plugin_code asc
select distinct tenant_id from sys_plugin_tenant where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0
select * from sys_plugin_version where plugin_code = #{pluginCode} and deleted = 0 order by created_at desc
